candidates.india_eligibility: India appears in the bank-payout country list, but the official page states that from May 2024 Stripe only accepts new Indian accounts on an invite-only basis. Without a pre-approved Stripe account, Indian merchants must use PayPal payouts.
candidates.hold_and_settlement: Net sales are held for 13 days; payouts are created twice monthly on the 1st and 15th, made available on the 14th and 28th, and can take 1–5 days to appear in the bank.
candidates.fees_and_fx: Base platform fee 5% + USD 0.50 on total order value; +1.5% international, +1.5% PayPal and +0.5% subscriptions. Payout outside the US: 1% via Stripe bank transfer or 3% capped at USD 30 via PayPal. PayPal payout is always USD.
candidates.demand_evidence: Marketplace discovery is not immediate: listing requires at least 3 sales in the seller's own store or USD 50 in own-store sales. No product-specific demand evidence.
candidates.time_to_first_sale: Unknown; own store and external acquisition are required before marketplace listing eligibility.
candidates.recurring_human_work: Low but non-zero after setup: product maintenance, customer support, refund/chargeback handling and ongoing policy checks.
candidates.unit_economics: Higher friction than Paddle for an India seller using PayPal: base 5% + USD 0.50, plus 1.5% international and 1.5% PayPal transaction fee, plus 3% PayPal payout fee outside the US; subscription and FX effects may add more.
candidates.ip_and_policy_status: Full current prohibited-product and supplier terms require owner review before any acceptance. Do not assume AI-generated services or third-party content are allowed without written policy confirmation.

payout_evidence.india_eligibility: India listed for bank payouts; new Stripe accounts from India are invite-only since May 2024; PayPal fallback required absent pre-approval.
payout_evidence.payout_methods: Bank transfer if Stripe pre-approved; otherwise verified PayPal account, USD.
payout_evidence.settlement: 13-day hold; twice-monthly payout cycles; 1–5 days to bank after payout.
payout_evidence.fees: 5% + USD 0.50; +1.5% international; +1.5% PayPal; +0.5% subscription; payout fee 1% Stripe bank outside US or 3% PayPal outside US.
payout_evidence.demand_signal: Marketplace listing requires 3 own-store sales or USD 50 own-store sales; no instant marketplace demand.

candidates.automation_fit: High for digital delivery and subscription webhooks once the store and product are approved; discovery and buyer acquisition remain external.
unknowns: Whether the owner already has a Stripe India account pre-approved by Stripe
Account-specific PayPal and bank payout verification
Product acceptance and exact applicable fees shown in the seller dashboard
candidates.note: Backup Merchant of Record only. Do not create a store or integrate it in parallel with the Getvik first-sale experiment.
